description: Runs in gs_revamp, mirrored here. From objective to ranked slate and corpus: a planner slices the objective into lanes and cards, the operator approves, and an executor searches adaptively inside a sovereign query budget, declaring a named move and harvesting terms after every evaluation, then walks citations and must earn its finish.

phases.phase_description: Query budget is law; cost, minutes and calls are backstops sized above it.
A slicing lens; lanes with term pools and cards; budget advisory; expected slate profile.
The operator approves or requests lane edits.
Low-confidence lanes get an online vocabulary harvest before the run.
Search with declared anatomy; batch judging; evaluation with next move and harvested terms; slate and frontier maintenance.
Seeds admitted by the reverse citation test; methodical cited-by walks on the reserve.
Completion basis, expansion review, dispositions; the verifier can refuse; the tail director answers stalls.
Assessment, merge, final order, editorial, synthesis, critic, corpus critic, author enrichment, export.

output_description: A ranked slate, a corpus, the truth ledger and the program frontier.
